scope: Closed ternary Goldbach statement checked with the released RH and GRH objects.

finite.proved_variable_height_rule: GoldbachFinite.through_height_of_rh: for an even B >= 100328530944 and H <= 10^27, it suffices to verify binary through B whenever 126.2 sqrt(H)+2 <= B.
finite.dudek_extra_hypothesis: Explicit zeta-zero count HSWN70, in addition to RH.
finite.basis: Linear reference scaling from the finite.md handoff. Excludes port, replay, joins, GRH and analytic authoring. The proof through 10^15+4 uses a ladder checked on 4.33.1 plus the binary prefix as a hypothesis.

ported_binary_pilot.excluded: toolchain, mathlib, one-time support compilation, witness generation and a failed 3700 MB-memory attempt
ported_binary_pilot.evidence: Fresh local checks used archived witnesses and a pure Lean backport of Nat.powMod. Original common and block sources match the archive SHA-256.

replay_mode: Each named module replayed against imported declarations.

interval_backend.scope: The dyadic bounds checker has a 22-module local dependency closure. The floating-point boxes still require conversion into accepted certificates.

ported_binary_prefix.basis: Sum of user and system times recorded with /usr/bin/time -p for bundled prefix modules. Some one-time support modules had no timing logs. Excludes producing witnesses and any retries.

H_2e19.scope: Linear projections for binary generation and interval checking beyond the complete archive. Analytic certification, the GRH import, joins, retries and a cold replay are separate.

wide_projection.scope: Wide producer and kernel interval proof from a single middle-location sample. Excludes one-time source, joins, analytic certificates, and release replay.

excludes: larger primality basis for the higher cutoff

cutoff_decision.strategy: Prioritize the common binary prefix. Replay the one-dimensional twist profile, including a high-mesh pilot, and compare before extending the binary cutoff.

cost_sensitivity.basis: Three accepted 1024-row campaign samples near the bottom, middle and top.
cost_sensitivity.interpretation: Moving the ternary cutoff through one slab pays if its avoidable kernel CPU time, allowing for reuse across slabs, exceeds the extra binary CPU time. Projections exclude common setup and final joins. Cutoffs above 752000 squared need a larger certified prime product and fresh rate samples.

excludes: larger primality basis for the higher cutoff

measured_bulk_handoffs.scope: Producer and kernel intervals. Each switch requires an accepted prime basis and a proof of the revised handoff. Prices omit setup and joins. Compare against future avoidable analytic work only.

diagnostics.status: Floating-point samples and composite midpoint quadrature, with no continuum certificate.

box_test.method: Floating-point monotone envelopes per box. No kernel-checked rounding or inclusion certificate.

adaptive_height_slabs.bounds: logs in rational outer intervals [44.442,46.052] and [46.051,56], with the order changed at N=10^20

grh_link.method: Direct read of the release compiler metadata; not a cold replay.
grh_link.finite_link_kernel_stage: The captured stack in grh-kernel-link-second.sample includes Lean.writeModule; the driver reaches this call only after env.addDeclCore succeeds.

small_twist_region.conclusion: twistedBudget N q delta oneCell oneCell <= 0.001*N/log N

binary_benchmark.trust: All four interval theorems checked on Lean 4.33.1. The two low samples prove the same interval with the same anchors.
binary_benchmark.exclusions: Shared basis, existing archive port, final joins and any retries. For the two low samples, the generator timing includes shared witness search and per-method inverse/row encoding. The two higher samples include whole process CPU spent in the producer. Local user+system CPU, concurrent load; extrapolations are not end-to-end timings.

accelerated_witnesses.source_comparison: Verified all generated row data and Lean commands identical after normalizing the namespace and redundant open.

wide_rate_samples.metrics: User and system CPU on arm64 Mac, Lean 4.33.1. Includes native producer plus stock kernel interval check, with shared basis and bitmap already built. Samples cover distinct intervals.

lower_dudek_price.basis: New three-location prime-product samples scaled by number of extra evens beyond archive; excludes establishing the explicit prime gap.

recommended_route.scope: Linear projections for binary generation and interval checking beyond the complete archive. Analytic certification, the GRH import, joins, retries and a cold replay are separate.

lookup_pilot.scope: Fixed-point integer enclosure checks at 1024 endpoints from the first slab. Excludes remaining scalar instructions, their relation to each rectangle, and the final theorem.

rational_witness_generation.evidence: The external generator checks rational bounds for every primitive step. The scalar program and final analytic integration have separate kernel acceptance statuses.

kernel_box_progress.canonical_external_audit: Checked 4333724 local instructions against 393891 shared instructions across all 17 slabs.

projected_profile_cover.scope: External arithmetic for the bounded twist intervals. The kernel results for the analytic transfer, the large-twist estimate and each completed group are recorded separately.

recorded_local_proof_cost.scope: Successful local module checks in the final proof dependency graph. Includes the finite and analytic join. The final release link, certificate generation, untimed imports and research attempts are separate.
